getAgentThreadMessages.description: Returns all messages for a given AI agent thread, ordered by creation time.

runVirtualUser.description: Turns a declared persona loose on this application and records what it finds. Returns immediately with a run id; read the result back with getVirtualUserRun.

getVirtualUserRun.name: getVirtualUserRun
getVirtualUserRun.title: Read a Virtual User Run
getVirtualUserRun.description: Reads a run back: its status, what it found, and the counts the engine kept.

listVirtualUserRuns.name: listVirtualUserRuns

listVirtualUserRuns.description: Reads back what the virtual users have been doing, newest first. Narrow with `persona` for one user's history.

getVirtualUserRunSteps.title: Read a Virtual User Transcript
getVirtualUserRunSteps.description: Every turn one run took, in order: what it called, what came back, and what that cost.

setVirtualUserSchedule.description: Says how often a persona should use the application on its own. Off until enabled, and every field left out keeps what it already had.

listVirtualUserSchedules.name: listVirtualUserSchedules

listVirtualUserSchedules.description: Which personas are on a clock, how often they run, and when each is next due.
